item.title: Megaspeed, firm at centre of Nvidia scandal, says Alice Huang left in 2025
item.description:
Company insists Alice Huang, who is accused of being a Chinese spy, left business in late 2025 Elon Musk joins 165,000 others calling for Nvidia to bring back Jensen Huang Business live – latest updates Megaspeed International, the company linked to the downfall of the Nvidia chief, Jensen Huang , says it is a “legitimate and lawful business” and has announced that its director, who allegedly had an affair with Jensen Huang, left the business in late 2025. The Singapore-based cloud computing company on the weekend said it was “aware of recent media reports containing assertions about our business, supply chain and global operations that are not supported by verifiable evidence”. Continue reading...

item.title: Third US aircraft carrier arrives in Middle East amid tensions with Iran
item.description:
Iran targeted Bahrain for the second time in three days, the first spate of direct attacks on the Persian Gulf state in weeks. Meanwhile the USS Theodore Roosevelt aircraft carrier arrived in the Central Command area of responsibility on Sunday, an Axios reporter said in a post on X, citing a US official. Bloomberg's Stuart Livingstone-Wallace reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Russia’s Andreeva defeats Ukraine’s Svitolina 7-5, 6-3 to win WTA Finals
item.description:

item.title: 2 planes collide on the ground in Miami, only minor injuries reported
item.description:
Two people injured after wingtip of Copa Airlines Boeing 737 struck nose of United Parcel Service Boeing 767 Two planes collided with one another on a taxiway at Miami’s international airport on Saturday night – a day after the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) issued an hours-long nationwide ground stop due to communication issues affecting multiple air traffic control centers. In a statement, the Trump administration-led FAA said the wingtip of a Copa Airlines Boeing 737 struck the nose of a United Parcel Service Boeing 767 “while the airplanes were taxiing at Miami International Airport”. item.title: SpaceX’s Starship returns to launch pad from orbit – video
item.description:
SpaceX made history by catching the upper stage of the largest and most powerful rocket ever built as a pivotal step for the company in its aim to create the first fully reusable rocket. Starship Flight 15, which launched at 5:47 p.m. ET Friday from Starbase in South Texas, achieved the monumental feat of catching the upper stage — called Starship, or “Ship” — of the rocket using the launch tower’s “chopstick” arms on its return to Earth at 4:20 p.m. ET Saturday. item.title: 'You're going to win the war': Harry praises war veterans on surprise Ukraine visit
item.description:
Duke of Sussex meets wounded veterans in city and says country could one day host Invictus Games Prince Harry has told Ukrainian soldiers they are going to win the war with Russia, during a surprise visit to the country. The Duke of Sussex met wounded veterans and medics in the city of Lviv, in the west of Ukraine, as he addressed a conference on treating those injured in war. He said he had taken a risk in travelling to the country, but that he had felt “warmth” when arriving on Saturday. Continue reading...

item.title: NSW halts new law to crack down on underquoting by real estate agents at 11th hour
item.description:
In summary A Sonoma County lawsuit alleges that one of northern California’s largest real estate brokerages shunted buyers into “dual agency” contracts. Claudia Ochoa and Cesar Gonzalez thought it was odd when they were told to ditch their real estate agent. Before the married couple could make an offer on the newly built single-family home on the west side of Santa Rosa, they were told that they would instead need to accept the services of a new agent who worked for W Real Estate. That’s the same brokerage, one of the largest in Northern California, that was representing the developer in the sale. But Ochoa and Gonzalez, first time buyers with full-time jobs and three young kids, were new to this. Having the same team of real estate agents represent both sides of the sale must just be another quirk of California’s mystifying home-buying process, they figured. Plus, this was the only…
